SELECT author_str, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.opinions WHERE author_str <> '' AND author_str IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many leisure and hospitality jobs were lost in spring 2020, and how many are there now?

SELECT year, period, value AS jobs_thousands FROM govblock_labor.bls_ce_data WHERE series_id = 'CES7000000001' AND ((cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' AND period IN ('M02', 'M04')) OR (cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND period = 'M12')) ORDER BY year, period
Which facilities in Texas released the most toxic chemicals into the air in 2019?

SELECT _4_facility_name, _6_city, sum(try_cast(_51_51_fugitive_air AS double) + try_cast(_52_52_stack_air AS double)) AS air_release FROM govblock_environment.tri_basic WHERE _8_st = 'TX' AND cast(_1_year AS varchar) = '2019' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the highest five-minute load in the Hudson Valley zone in 2021?
SELECT max(try_cast(load AS double)) AS highest FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_load_pal WHERE name = 'HUD VL' AND substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2021'
Which states' bachelor's-degree colleges have the highest six-year completion rate on average?

SELECT stabbr, round(avg(try_cast(c150_4 AS double)), 3) AS completion_rate FROM govblock_education.scorecard_most_recent_institution WHERE cast(preddeg AS varchar) = '3' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How did the Supreme Court vote in Brown v. Board of Education?
SELECT case_name, date_filed, scdb_votes_majority, scdb_votes_minority FROM govblock_courts.opinion_clusters WHERE case_name LIKE 'Brown v. Board of Education%' LIMIT 5
Which countries are the first filing place for the most published U.S. applications?
SELECT foreign_country_filed AS country, count(DISTINCT pgpub_id) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.pv_pg_foreign_priority GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How do SEC operating companies divide by filer status, from large accelerated filers down?

SELECT category, count(*) AS companies, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_sec.submissions_companies WHERE entitytype = 'operating' AND category <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which particles in the Particle Data Group listings carry a charge of plus two?
SELECT name, charge FROM govblock_physics.pdg_pdgparticle WHERE try_cast(charge AS double) = 2 LIMIT 10
On average, what share of assets do large multiemployer pension plans hold in stocks?
SELECT avg(try_cast(pen_stock_prcnt AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_nonprofits.dol_f_sch_r WHERE pen_stock_prcnt IS NOT NULL
Which states have the lowest share of adults who are citizens?
SELECT geoname, round(100.0 * try_cast(cvap_est AS double) / try_cast(adu_est AS double), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_elections.cvap_state WHERE lntitle = 'Total' ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10
How many federal loans were made in fiscal 2022?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_award_search WHERE category = 'loans' AND cast(fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2022'
Which hospital stays were most common among Medicare patients in 2021?
Medicare Inpatient Hospitals By Provider And Service

SELECT drg_desc AS diagnosis_group, sum(try_cast(tot_dschrgs AS double)) AS discharges FROM govblock_health.medicare_inpatient_hospitals_by_provider_and_service WHERE source_file LIKE '%DY21%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many filings has EDGAR taken in each recent year?
SELECT substr(cast(filingdate AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS filings FROM govblock_sec.submissions_filings GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 10
Which companies received the most U.S. patents in 2023?

SELECT a.disambig_assignee_organization, count(DISTINCT p.patent_id) AS patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_patent p JOIN govblock_patents.pv_g_assignee_disambiguated a ON a.patent_id = p.patent_id WHERE p.patent_date LIKE '2023%' AND a.disambig_assignee_organization <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many companies filed a 10-K that reported net income for fiscal year 2024?
SELECT count(DISTINCT cik) AS companies FROM govblock_sec.companyfacts WHERE concept = 'NetIncomeLoss' AND form = '10-K' AND cast(fy AS varchar) = '2024'
Which counties are split among the most ZIP code areas?
SELECT namelsad_county_20, geoid_county_20, count(DISTINCT geoid_zcta5_20) AS zip_areas FROM govblock_census.rel2020_tab20_zcta520_county20 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the highest hourly output of any power plant in Texas on August 1, 2023?
SELECT facility_name, unit_id, hour, gross_load_mw FROM govblock_environment.campd_emissions_hourly WHERE state = 'TX' AND date = DATE '2023-08-01' ORDER BY gross_load_mw DESC LIMIT 10
Which states enrolled the most public school students in 2024-25?

SELECT statename, sum(try_cast(student_count AS double)) AS students FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_052 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND total_indicator = 'Education Unit Total' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
In how many patents does aspirin appear?
SELECT count(DISTINCT c1) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_patent WHERE c0 = '2244'
In which states is energy most expensive per million Btu?

SELECT substr(series_id, 12, 2) AS state, try_cast(value AS double) AS dollars_per_million_btu FROM govblock_energy.eia_seds_data WHERE series_id LIKE 'SEDS.TETCD.%.A' AND length(series_id) = 15 AND substr(series_id, 12, 2) NOT IN ('US', 'X3', 'X5') AND period = '2023' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many medical device recalls were started in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.fda_device_recall WHERE substr(event_date_initiated, 1, 4) = '2023'
Among districts with at least 10,000 students, which spent the most per pupil in fiscal 2017?

SELECT name, stabbr, round(try_cast(tcurelsc AS double) / try_cast(v33 AS double)) AS per_pupil FROM govblock_education.ccd_sdf WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '17' AND try_cast(v33 AS double) >= 10000 AND try_cast(tcurelsc AS double) > 0 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of Regulations.gov dockets are rulemakings?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN replace(dockettype, '"', '') = 'Rulemaking' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_regulations.regulations_gov_dockets
Which modes of action are most common among drugs with a known mechanism?
SELECT action_type, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_drug_mechanism WHERE action_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
